meta.name: handoff
meta.description: Compact the current conversation into a handoff document for another agent to pick up.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将当前对话压缩为交接文档，供其他智能体继续处理
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个智能体之间传递对话上下文
copy.tagline_en: Compact the current conversation into a handoff document for another agent
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to pass conversation context between multiple agents

howto.what: 把当前对话压缩成交接文档，保存到系统临时目录；文档里会列出建议调用的技能，并引用已有文件，还会隐去 API 密钥等敏感信息。
howto.when: 当你要求生成交接文档时触发。

say.text: 把当前对话生成一份交接文档
say.note: 生成后自动保存到临时目录

say.text: 为下一个会话写交接文档，重点是继续推荐算法
say.note: 参数会被当作下一会话的用途

say.text: 生成交接文档，建议用到的技能写进里面
say.note: 文档会包含 suggested skills 部分

howto.what_en: Compress the current conversation into a handoff document, saved to the OS temporary directory. The document lists suggested skills, references existing artifacts by path, and redacts sensitive info.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to generate a handoff document.

say_en.text: Summarize this conversation into a handoff document.
Write a handoff for the next session focusing on the recommendation algorithm.
Generate a handoff document that suggests skills to use.
